messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a controlled rollout of feature flag `fast_cache_v2` to 10% on prod today at 16:00 UTC. Safe default will remain OFF until we verify smoke checks.

Alex: Rollout command I’ll use:```
/ff toggle fast_cache_v2 --env prod --pct 10 --actor alex
```

Alex: Smoke checklist I want covered: 1) no 5xx on /generate, 2) p95 latency < 250ms, 3) no kv cache errors in logs, 4) sampling of outputs for quality.

Priya: I can monitor logs and the /generate 5xx dashboard. What window should we watch before increasing pct? :eyes:

Alex: Let’s watch 20m. If all green we hold, then 60m and we can consider bumping. If anything spikes, rollback immediately.

Sam: I’m oncall until 17:30 UTC, available to run rollback if needed. Add me to the thread when you start.

Maria: Please add a canary header so we can filter traces: `x-experiment: fast_cache_v2-canary`. Also make sure the rollout tag is on the deploy so tracing links to this run.

Alex: Good call — will include the header. I’ll tag the rollout in the release notes and pin a Grafana snapshot.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by Alex — `fast_cache_v2` -> prod @ 2024-03-17T16:00:00Z (10%). ID: rb-7342. Notifications will be posted to #eng-platform.

Priya: Quick config check — what are safe defaults in case someone hits the ff API manually?

Alex: Safe defaults: `enabled=false`, `default_pct=0`, `grace_period=10m`, `max_burst_pct=15`. I’ll add this to the feature flag entry in the config repo.

Sam: Rollback command ready:```
/ff toggle fast_cache_v2 --env prod --pct 0 --actor sam
```

Maria: I’ll take quality sampling for the first 100 requests routed to canary and post any diffs in this thread.

Alex: Thanks all — I’ll start the rollout at 16:00 UTC and ping here. If you see any oddness call rollback and post the snippet of logs (paste the top 20 lines). :thumbsup:
